The '''Elrood Sector Fleet''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]], assigned to the defense of [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Villis Andal]]. It consisted of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'' and ''[[Thunderflare]]'', the [[Bayonet-class light cruiser|''Bayonet''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Rintonne's Flame]]'', and smaller ships: 12 [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol craft]], customs vessels, [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboats]], and [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The ''[[Brazen]]'' was later assigned to the sector fleet but it was [[Battle of Derilyn|destroyed]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
